spikes.title: Guard throw semantics in system.transform and chat.params
spikes.decision: Run the guard in the plugin hooks (D1, D8): a stop Error for blocking verdicts and a "temporarily at capacity" Error for retryable ones. No loopback gate.

spikes.title: Fail-closed provider injection through the plugin config hook
spikes.decision: Keep the fail-closed plugin-injected provider (D3): no provider block in the profile, and no loopback gate for provider resolution.

spikes.title: Budget preflight: thrown overflow object turns into compaction
spikes.decision: Keep the in-plugin budget preflight (D6): throw the overflow object for normal agents, a stop Error for the compaction agent and for the loop breaker.

spikes.title: XDG isolation canaries and shell.env restoration
spikes.decision: Keep the isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME plus OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR clean room (D2), with shell.env restoring the original XDG_CONFIG_HOME for agent commands.

spikes.title: Built-in agents disabled (build, plan, title)
spikes.decision: Disable build, plan and title (D22). The TUI rendering itself stays a manual M0 and G10 check; run and the server session path are covered automatically.

spikes.title: Bash allow-list under the Windows shell
spikes.decision: Keep the rendered bash allow-list (spec 8.5.2). No ocu-compile.cmd wrapper is needed; the compile command may keep its quoted -clp argument.

spikes.title: Models catalogue fetch disabled
spikes.decision: Keep OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 in the clean-room launch environment (spec 8.1).

spikes.title: Offline start with a failing background dependency install
spikes.decision: Offline starts need no pre-seed, but the launch environment must set npm_config_fetch_retries=0; the pre-seed stays an optional setup extra for quiet logs.

spikes.title: PowerShell process probe over stdin
spikes.decision: Keep the stdin transport: `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command -` with the script text piped in as one `& { ... }` block ending in a blank line. `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File` stays the documented fallback.

spikes.title: MCP tool argument policy and resource permissions
spikes.decision: Enforce the MCP argument policy in the plugin `tool.execute.before` hook (spec 11.3), and keep the editor agent behind the exact-name allow-list plus `read: { "mcp:<server>:*": "allow" }`.

spikes.title: debug agent / debug config introspection and schema keys
spikes.decision: Use `debug agent <name>` for V-b and V-c and `debug config` for V-d, both with a timeout and one retry, and generate `schema-keys-1.18.31.json` from `opencode generate` (components.schemas.Config, AgentConfig, CommandConfig).

spikes.title: MCP for Unity instance id formula
spikes.decision: Take the spec fallback for v0.1: the editor agent matches on the instance NAME from `mcpforunity://instances` and stops unless exactly one instance matches the project name, with a warning. A computed `<name>@<hash>` is only shown as a hint, never used to pin an instance, until a live Editor check confirms the exact `Application.dataPath` string.

spikes.title: MCP for Unity HTTP endpoint path
spikes.decision: Build the hub URL as <base>/mcp, default base http://127.0.0.1:8080, and take the spec fallback for discovery: the user pastes the HTTP base URL from the MCP for Unity window (doctor pre-fills the documented default and the URL of an existing configurator entry when one is there). Nothing outside the Editor's own preferences reveals a changed port.
